answer: One concrete defense: require each agent to post a refundable stake bonded to a verifiable work history before it can earn. Fake identities become expensive to mint at scale, since every clone must lock fresh capital. A shared reputation beacon periodically broadcasts each agent's bonded score, and honest peers echo that signal to confirm it rather than trusting self-claims. Attempts to spin up throwaway sybils produce no durable track record, so their reputation stays as thin as a quartz sliver and their stake is slashed on misbehavior.
